description.value: Hike-in backcountry camp at Flora Lake within Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park, set amid old-growth forested slopes and spectacular subalpine terrain 150 km east of Vancouver. Advance backcountry registration required, no fires permitted, and no cell service once on park road.

raw_osm.description: Two wooden tent pads located beside lake, one metal bear cache, and one open air pit toilet.
raw_osm.name: Flora Lake Camp

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM provides detailed explicit tags for this backcountry site including drinking_water=no, shower=no, washing_machine=no, openfire=no, reservation=no, and a description confirming two tent pads, a metal bear cache, and a pit toilet. The BC Parks website corroborates Flora Lake as one of four active backcountry camps in Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park, confirms backcountry registration is required, and states fires are not permitted in the backcountry. No cycling-specific amenities, discounts, or infrastructure are mentioned in either source.
concerns: No address or phone number available in OSM or on the website.
The OSM website URL links to the broader Sx̱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park page; no dedicated page for Flora Lake Camp specifically was found.
Very limited capacity — only 2 tent pads; not suitable for groups.
No potable water on site; cyclists must treat water sourced from the lake.
Website notes there is no cell phone reception past the On the Way store on Chilliwack Lake Road — relevant safety note for cyclists traveling to this area.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Flora Lake Camp is a legitimate, active BC Parks backcountry campsite with bear-safe food storage and toilet facilities that would serve bikepacking and backcountry cycle tourists; the listing should clearly convey the minimal amenities and backcountry-only access.
enrichment_extras.notes: Backcountry registration is required before visiting. Facility details (tent pads, bear cache, pit toilet) are sourced from the OSM description tag, corroborated by the BC Parks website listing Flora Lake as an active backcountry camp.

wow_evidence: hike-in backcountry camp... old-growth forested slopes and spectacular subalpine terrain 150 km east of Vancouver
